# AP agent setup

Owner: Jordan Lee (AP). The agent uses three tool servers: mail (ap@corp.example), files (/workspace) and vendor tools (vendor-tools.corp.example). Settings live in /workspace/agent/mcp.json.

## Open setup tasks

- Update the mail signature to the new AP phone line.
- Add Saltmarsh Supply to the vendor list in the vendor tools.
- Review the agent's access with security by November 7.
